  2. 2

    Organize your library

  3. 3

Frequently asked questions

How do I save a video to my playlist?

After installing, click the + button next to any video on YouTube and choose a playlist.

Does the sleep timer work for music?

Yes. The sleep timer pauses any playing YouTube video or music track when the time runs out.

Can I customize my playlist icons?

Yes. Choose from a range of colors and icons to make each playlist easy to find.

What are the free limits?

Up to 3 playlists with 6 videos each. Premium ($39 one-time) removes the limits.
